The '''Task Force ''Vengeance''''' was a task force formed to pacify the [[Airam sector/Legends|Airam sector]]. It was headed by the [[Executor-class Star Dreadnought/Legends|''Executor''-class Star Dreadnought]] [[Vengeance (Executor-class)/Legends|''Vengeance'']] under [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Wooyou Senn]].

==Description==
===Capital ships===
[[File:ISD Rage.jpg|thumb|left|250px|The ISD ''Rage'', which was part of Task Force Vengeance.]]
Task Force ''Vengeance'' consisted of multiple capital ships, led by the [[Executor-class Star Dreadnought/Legends|''Executor''-class Star Dreadnought]] SSD [[Vengeance (Executor-class)/Legends|''Vengeance'']]. The task force deployed various [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyers]] including ISD [[Conqueror (Imperial-class)|''Conqueror'']], ISD [[Juggernaut (Star Destroyer)|''Juggernaut'']], ISD [[Nemesis (Task Force Vengeance)|''Nemesis'']], ISD [[Rage (Imperial-class)/Legends|''Rage'']], ISD [[Titan (Imperial-class)|''Titan'']], and the ISD [[Wasp (Imperial-class)|''Wasp'']]. Additionally, [[Victory-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Victory''-class Star Destroyers]] were also part of the task force, including the VSD [[Inexorable (Victory-class)|''Inexorable'']], VSD [[Judicator (Victory-class)|''Judicator'']], and VSD [[Stormhawk (Victory-class)|'' Stormhawk'']].<ref name="BoP" />

The task force additionally fielded an [[Immobilizer 418 Interdictor-class Heavy Cruiser]], the INT ''[[Compellor/Legends|Compellor]]'', as well as two [[Strike-class medium cruiser|''Strike''-class medium cruisers]]. These were the STRKC [[Ironhand (Strike-class)|''Ironhand'']] and STRKC [[Talon (Strike-class)|''Talon'']]. Four [[EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate/Legends|EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigates]] were also part of the task force, including FRG [[Abolisher (EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate)|''Abolisher'']], FRG ''[[Damocles]]'', FRG [[Fang (EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate)|''Fang'']], and FRG ''[[Pincer]]''. These [[Frigate/Legends|frigates]] were supplemented by the [[Nebulon-B2 frigate]]s M/FRG''[[Harpy]]'', M/FRG [[Lightning (Nebulon-B2 frigate)|''Lightning'']], M/FRG [[Subjugator (Nebulon-B2 frigate)|''Subjugator'']], and M/FRG ''[[Tupolev]]''. The three [[Ton-Falk-class escort carrier|''Ton-Falk''-class escort carriers]] ESC [[Abolisher (escort carrier)|''Abolisher'']], ESC ''[[Hyperion]]'', and ESC [[Tyrant (escort carrier)|''Tyrant'']] were all part of the task force.<ref name="BoP" />

Multiple smaller warships and support vessels rounded out the task force. These included the [[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90 corvettes]] CRV [[1138 (CR90 corvette)|''1138'']], CRV ''[[Gotal (CR90 corvette)|Gotal 1]]'', CRV ''[[Gotal 2]]'', CRV ''327-B'', ''327-C'', and two others. Other corvettes included the [[CR92a Assassin-class corvette|CR92a ''Assassin''-class corvettes]] M/CRV ''[[124]]'', M/CRV ''327-A'', M/CRV ''[[337]]'', and four others. Three [[Cargo ferry|cargo ferries]] and at least nine [[BFF-1 bulk freighter/Legends|BFF-1 bulk freighters]] were also used.<ref name="BoP" />

===Subunits===
[[Battlegroup Orion]] was a subordinate formation organized under the task force's structure. The [[Battle group/Legends|battlegroup]] consisted of several ships, including ''Conqueror'' and ''Nemesis''. The ISD ''Rage'' fielded [[Avenger Squadron/Legends|Avenger Squadron]], [[Beta Squadron (Gelgelar)|Beta Squadron]], as well as [[Gamma Squadron/Legends|Gamma Squadron]]. Beta and Gamma Squadrons were reformed into [[Talon Squadron (Galactic Empire)|Talon Squadron]].<ref name="BoP" />

==History==
The naval unit commenced operations at roughly the same time that a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] task force centered on the cruiser [[Liberty/Legends|''Liberty'']] set up a new [[Shipyard/Legends|shipyard]] in the [[Nocto system/Legends|Nocto system]]. These forces subsequently engaged in a long campaign. During the campaign, the task force sustained losses to their ''Imperial''-class Star Destroyers. The ''Conqueror'', ''Nemesis'', and ''Rage'' were all destroyed while ''Juggernaut'', ''Titan'', and ''Wasp'' were damaged. Additionally, the ''Victory''-class Star Destroyer ''Stormhawk'' was also destroyed, as was the Immobilizer heavy cruiser ''Compellor'' after it was captured by the Rebels. Furthermore, two ''Strike''-class medium cruisers deployed by the task force, ''Ironhand'' and ''Talon'' were both destroyed during the campaign, as were the EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigates ''Fang'' and ''Pincer'', while the ''Damocles'' was damaged. Similarly, the Nebulon-B2 frigates ''Harpy'' and ''Subjugator'' were eliminated, while the ''Lightning'' was also damaged.<ref name="BoP" />

[[File:Battle of Rocrin.png|thumb|right|250px|Several ships of the task force]]
Three of the task forces ''Ton-Falk''-class escort carriers were all destroyed; the ''Abolisher'', the ''Hyperion'', and the ''Tyrant'', while five CR90 corvettes were also annihilated. These corvettes were ''1138'', ''Gotal 1'', ''Gotal 2'', ''327-B'', and ''327-C'', and a further two others with troops were also destroyed. ''124'', ''327-A'', and ''337''&ndash; CR92a ''Assassin''-class corvettes, were also eliminated during the campaign along with one other that was loaded with troops and equipment. Additionally, two of at least six modular conveyors were destroyed, as was one cargo ferry and three BFF-1 bulk freighters.<ref name="BoP" />

At the end the campaign against the Rebel forces, Admiral Senn and the ''Vengeance'' were destroyed by an intense Rebel attack. Both the Rebels and the Imperials in Airam were significantly damaged and left in a stalemate. Task Force ''Vengeance'' failed to destroy the Rebel presence in the Airam sector, or force the compliance of the Airam leaders.<ref name="BoP" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Imperial campaign of ''Star Wars: X-Wing vs. TIE Fighter: Balance of Power'' derives its name from this task force. Although the last missions are open ended (they can be played as either Rebels or Imperials), the ultimate outcome is not held to favor the Empire or the Rebellion.
